title: Christmas and new year opening times at Companies House
text:
Same day services

 If you’re using a same day service to change a company name online or incorporate a company (software only), apply before:

 • 12pm on Thursday 24 December or we may not process your application until Tuesday 29 December

 • 2pm on Thursday 31 December or we may not process your application until Monday 4 January

 Reduction of capital (form SH19)

 You must file your  statement of capital when reducing capital in a company (SH19)  and any supporting documents before 11am on Thursday 24 December. You must use the  upload a document to Companies House  service to file your documents.

 If we receive your documents after 11am, we may not process your application until Tuesday 29 December.

 Certified copies of certificates and documents

 You must place your order before 11am to use the express dispatch service on:

 • Friday 18 December

 • Thursday 31 December

 If you order after 11am we’ll still produce your order, but we cannot guarantee when it will be dispatched.

 Ordering certified documents and certificates from Companies House .

 Online services

 Companies House online services are available throughout the Christmas and new year period.

 You can use our online services to:

 • file your company accounts 

 • file your confirmation statement 

 • make changes to your company 

 • close your company 

 You’ll need your company authentication code . Allow plenty of time if you need to request a code as we’ll send it to your company by post.

 We cannot accept postal delays as a reason to appeal a late filing penalty.
